BFA.note: Enrolment has not started; no count given.
Nothing stated on a number at birth.
Only enrolment is said to be run by public structures; no operation of a system in service is stated.
Improved public registers are an expected benefit only; no register is stated to use the identifier.

facts.fact: Burkina Faso's government adopted on 30 July 2026 a decree for a national enrolment campaign to give every resident a unique electronic identifier under the World Bank-financed WURI project, per wearetech.africa.
